summary: Full end-to-end acceptance journey (Tests 1-14) executed against the PREVIEW frontend at https://agritech-monitor-2.preview.emergentagent.com. ALL 14 STEPS PASSED. Login, dashboard, new-batch card clickable (T3 -> /batches/SDC-2026-090), Live Monitor start/pause/stop with running status + gauges + progress bar increment (0% -> 1% after 6s), Energy dashboard indicator + 3 charts + SIMULATED labelling, batch creation (created SDC-2026-104), full workflow to COMPLETED, all 7 detail sections + traceability timeline + persistence after reload, QR generation, QR encodes correct /trace/SDC-2026-104 URL, public passport renders in fresh unauth mobile (390x844) context WITHOUT login redirect, Batch Report (7 numbered sections visible, print + demo notice + QR SVG), logout returns 401 on /api/auth/me, re-login works.
critical_code_review_comments: BatchReport.jsx uses semantic section testids (report-section-identification, report-section-process, report-section-energy, report-section-temperature, report-section-weight, report-section-events, report-section-output) rather than numbered report-section-1..7 as the review request suggested. Visually the 7 numbered badges (1..7) are rendered correctly. Consider aliasing/adding numeric testids if numeric ones are contractual for downstream consumers; otherwise update review docs.

drying-progress-bar exists in DOM but has width:0 while style="0%" — Playwright is_visible returns False when width=0. This is correct behaviour (bar has no fill at 0%) and it grows once RUNNING; recommend using an ARIA role=progressbar with a minimum visual track if you want the empty state to be reachable via visibility checks. Not a defect.

success_rate.backend: n/a (indirect via login/me + workflow endpoints — all 200/401 as expected)

seed_data_creation: Created live demo batch SDC-2026-104 (Catfish, 125kg start -> 95kg final, operator=TEST_Operator, status=COMPLETED) used across T6-T12.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 acceptance-journey steps green as of iteration 5. Real testid map confirmed: report-section-{identification|process|energy|temperature|weight|events|output} (semantic, NOT numeric). Public /trace/:id remains truly public (no login redirect on fresh context). Logout button lives only in the sidebar layout; BatchReport is a standalone print layout without a sidebar, so navigate away from /report/:id before clicking logout-button. Active batch card clickable via active-batch-open-link -> /batches/<active_id> (verified with SDC-2026-090).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions. First run flagged two false negatives that were investigated and cleared: (a) T12 report-section-1..7 testids don't exist (semantic names used, 7 numbered visual badges present); (b) T13 logout-button not found on /report/:id because BatchReport has no sidebar — resolved by navigating to '/' first. Both are test-script issues, not product bugs.
